mechanism: Benazepril may increase chloroquine levels through competitive renal tubular secretion inhibition, and chloroquine can cause cardiomyopathy which may be exacerbated by ACE inhibitor use in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor renal function, cardiac function (baseline ECG/echocardiogram if prolonged chloroquine use), and watch for chloroquine toxicity signs; adjust benazepril dose if renal impairment develops.
